stories.title: Xpeng shares sink as weak delivery forecast overshadows robot unit's $6.3 billion valuation
stories.summary: Xpeng stock fell after the company gave a delivery forecast that missed expectations. The weak outlook overshadowed news that its robotics unit carries a $6.3 billion valuation. Investing.com and CNBC both tied the drop to demand concerns.
stories.whyItMatters: Xpeng is a bellwether for China's EV export ambitions, so a soft delivery outlook signals demand risk across the sector.
whatToWatch: Xpeng's next delivery report
Any update on the robotics unit's funding or spinoff plans
questions: What is driving the weaker delivery forecast?
Does the robot unit's valuation hold up if EV deliveries keep missing?

stories.title: Treasury yields fall on report Treasury may tap General Account for bond buybacks
stories.summary: Treasury yields declined after CNBC reported the Treasury could use its General Account to help fund bond buybacks. The report points to a funding source outside new debt issuance, which eased pressure on bonds.
stories.whyItMatters: A non-issuance funding path for buybacks would mean less net new Treasury supply, a bullish signal for bond markets.
whatToWatch: Confirmation or denial from Treasury officials
Details on the size and timing of any buyback funded this way
questions: Would using the General Account this way affect money markets?

stories.whyItMatters: Gold's rally reflects hedging against dollar weakness and shifting Treasury financing plans, both signals macro traders track closely.

stories.title: Shein targets $27 billion Hong Kong IPO, a fraction of its 2022 valuation
stories.summary: Fast-fashion retailer Shein is targeting a $27 billion valuation for a Hong Kong IPO, CNBC reported. That figure is far below the valuation it commanded in 2022.
stories.whyItMatters: The steep valuation cut reflects investor caution toward Shein amid regulatory and reputational scrutiny, and it tests appetite for other Chinese consumer listings.
whatToWatch: Formal IPO filing details and pricing
Investor reception once the listing launches
questions: What drove the valuation down so sharply from 2022?
